When we are displaying a Contract we are either on the Project Overview page of the PO or on the Contributor Dashboard of the Contributor. comments.author: amihaiemil
comments.body:
@criske Can you pls take care of this? It's really easy, just remove the line

``.add("project", new JsonProject(contract.project()))``

and also remove any jquery/front-end stuff which does something with the project attribute from the response.

The Project should not be part of the JsonContract because we don't need it and it also contains sensitive information like Wallet data, which should only be visible to the PO. 

We don't need it because we display contracts either on the PO Project page (so the Project is already there from an earlier call), or on the Contributor Dashboard page, where the project's fullName is enough, the Contributor doesn't need to see any more info :D
